gates.reason: Judge-bound artifacts include unrestricted worker output and diff bytes without provenance or a ~/.claude-content egress guard.

Inspected digest binding, frozen-input reconstruction, attempt lifecycle validation, objective-check derivation, blind-order reconciliation, and final-result rederivation; no reproducible arithmetic or provenance defect found.
Inspected parsing and assembly paths; source, prompt, stream, retry, and untracked-file limits provide fixed bounds, with no demonstrated hot-path regression or unbounded recomputation.

findings.title: Sealed judge payload can contain subscription-protected ~/.claude content
findings.what: artifactText concatenates the worker's unrestricted final result, tracked patch, and every untracked entry's bytes. Its only redaction covers three path/model strings. expectedPayloads then places that text directly into both Claude judge requests. No structured origin provenance, forbidden-source assertion, or rejection prevents a worker result or worktree file containing copied ~/.claude data from being accepted and sent using the subscription-backed Claude invocation.
findings.fix: Before accepting or constructing judge payloads, require cryptographically bound structured provenance proving every included byte originated from the disposable worktree and reject worker output or artifacts containing data sourced from ~/.claude. Bind that governance result into the input, request, and pre-dispatch digests; fail closed when it is absent or invalid.
findings.acceptance: A fixture whose worker result or diff contains a unique canary copied from a simulated ~/.claude file is rejected before any judge dispatch, while ordinary worktree-only evidence still validates; tampering with or omitting the bound provenance receipt also fails validation.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read the path validation and artifact assembly at lines 249-323, frozen evidence binding at lines 672-758, payload construction at lines 761-775, and pre-dispatch checks at lines 888-915. Path traversal and size checks do not establish content origin, and the pre-dispatch validator checks payload equality but no ADR-0008 egress condition, so the candidate survives.
